business.name: Samiksha
business.whatsappGreeting: Hi Samiksha! I'd like to book a mehendi appointment.

items.label: Full Bridal
items.blurb: Full-coverage bridal work — jaali nets, layered mandalas, and the groom's initials hidden inside the pattern.

items.label: Indo-Western
items.blurb: Modern geometry paired with traditional motifs. Clean lines, lots of breathing room, very photogenic on reels.

items.label: Mandala Art
items.blurb: One bold centred mandala with radiating petals and dot work. The most requested single-motif design.

items.label: Jaali Net
items.blurb: Fine lattice net-work inspired by Mughal screens, filled with tiny florals. Slow, detailed, and stunning up close.

items.label: Dulha–Dulhan
items.blurb: The bride and groom drawn face to face across both palms, framed by a shehnai border and floral arches.

items.label: Peacock
items.blurb: A full peacock with a spread tail flowing from the wrist to the fingers — the classic figure motif.

items.label: Doli & Baraat
items.blurb: The whole wedding procession — palanquin, dholak, baraatis — told as a scene running up the forearm.

items.label: Dancing Ladies
items.blurb: Rajasthani ghoomar dancers in a ring, skirts fanning out, with mirror-dot detailing between them.

sections.title: Arabic Mehandi
sections.subtitle: Bold flowing florals with open, airy spacing

items.label: Floral Vines
items.blurb: A single diagonal vine of roses and leaves sweeping from wrist to index finger. Fast, bold, always flattering.

items.label: Bold Leafy
items.blurb: Thick strokes, heavy shading, and large leaf clusters. Reads beautifully from a distance in photos.

items.label: Gulf Style
items.blurb: Khaleeji-inspired outlines with glitter-free shading and long trailing tendrils down the fingers.

items.label: Minimal Arabic
items.blurb: A slim floral trail on one or two fingers only. Perfect for office days, small pujas and last-minute plans.

pricing.title: Pricing Packages
pricing.subtitle: Per person · bridal includes a free trial
pricing.note: Group and festival bookings get a per-person discount.

items.name: Ananya R.
items.text: Samiksha did my bridal mehendi at 5 AM without a single complaint. The stain came out almost black by the next morning. Guests kept asking for her number.

items.name: Fatima S.
items.text: Booked her for eight of us at home. Fast, spotless, and she brought her own stool and light. Worth every rupee.

items.name: Divya M.
items.text: I wanted something minimal for work the next day and she got it exactly right. Very good at reading what you actually want.

items.name: Sneha K.
items.text: The dulha-dulhan figures on my palms were unbelievable. Everyone at the sangeet wanted photos of my hands.

rules.r: Three packages: Basic Rs 999 (one hand, simple), Bridal Rs 2999 (full hands + feet, includes a free trial), and Premium Rs 4999 (bride + 4 guests). Individual designs start from Rs 899 — tap Book Now for an exact quote.
Figures Mehandi is Samiksha's speciality — Dulha–Dulhan portraits, peacocks, the doli and baraat scene, and ghoomar dancers. These run Rs 1699 to Rs 3299 depending on coverage.
Designer Mehandi covers Full Bridal (Rs 2999), Indo-Western (Rs 1999), Mandala Art (Rs 1299) and Jaali Net (Rs 2299). Tap any tile in that section to see the details.
Arabic Mehandi is bold flowing florals with open spacing — Floral Vines from Rs 1199, Bold Leafy Rs 1499, Gulf Style Rs 1799, and Minimal Arabic from Rs 899. Most take under 90 minutes.
Bridal is Rs 2999 for full hands and feet, 4–6 hours, with a free trial session beforehand. In wedding season (Nov–Feb) dates go 2–3 months ahead, so book early.
Samiksha has 7 years of experience and has done mehendi for over 500 brides, with a 4.9 rating across 480 bookings.
Keep the paste on 6–8 hours, then scrape it off instead of washing. Avoid water for 12 hours and dab on mustard oil. The colour darkens over 48 hours and lasts 7–10 days.
100% natural henna — no PPD or black henna, which can burn skin. Safe for kids and pregnancy. Do mention any allergies in your booking note.
Samiksha is based in Andheri West and travels across Mumbai and Thane. Travel is free within 10 km, Rs 300 beyond that. Home, venue, or studio all work.
Hours are 9 AM to 8 PM, all seven days. Early-morning bridal slots (even 5 AM) can be arranged — just mention the time when you book.
Tap Book Now, or message 91 88303 92310 directly on WhatsApp. A 30% deposit holds the date, refundable up to 7 days before.
The deposit is 30% of the package, fully refundable if you cancel more than 7 days before your date.
Group bookings are very common. Premium (Rs 4999) covers the bride plus 4 guests, and larger groups get a per-person discount.
Namaste! I can help with designs, pricing, timings or aftercare. What are you planning for?
Happy to help! Tap Book Now whenever you're ready and Samiksha will take it from there.
